speaker: margery_pell
text: The gowns are back on the stair. The yard was a poor yard.

speaker: james_burbage
text: A poor yard on a playing day is a locked rent. What did they do with my afternoon.

speaker: margery_pell
text: They're all over the water. There's a new play with a giant in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The afternoon was Titus, and I was not in it. A thin yard is no riddle if the river has a new giant.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I played to caps and empty boards. A man can hear a thin yard in his own voice. What was the giant.

speaker: hired_men
text: I saw the end of it. Alleyn in a lion's skin, and a club like a ship's mast, and monsters.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: How tall were the monsters. I do not want a louder thunder than his. I want the height.

speaker: hired_men
text: I will not swear a height. I was at the back. I did not ask what it cost. I came away when the mast came down.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The price is the question I am not going to be answered. I want what the mast cost them in timber. Nobody has brought me a bill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not go, sir. I have no bill, and I will not invent one.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Invent me no sum. Blackwage and Hoope are ten shillings the week, and they were on my stage, not over the water. That is a number I do know.

speaker: margery_pell
text: My box was light. I am not ashamed of a light box when the river is the cause. I am ashamed of a light box and a lie.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: No lie. The lion-skin was the cause. One monster, or a muster of them.

speaker: hired_men
text: A muster. I will not swear the number. I will swear the skin, and the mast, and the noise at the end. The end is what I saw.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art scowling into that cup as if the skin were in it. The skin is over the water. It is not in this house.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I am scowling at the waste. They have a giant. We had a thin yard that could hear itself. I want a part a man can stand up in, not a pole.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Stand up in it on my stage, then. Their mast is a story. My posts are the house. I am not matching a lion.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not match them, sir. A mast is their labour. I am not writing a mast.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The term is open. It runs to the second of June. The gowns will sit here when they are not sitting over the water. You have the days.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Give it to me when it is a man. I will not play a club. Do not tell the yard tonight what thou art writing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not tell it. The king stays at home. This house had a thin afternoon, and the news of a skin.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I know a gown when it pays. Today the gowns paid the other stair.

speaker: hired_men
text: I went on my own feet. I owe no one a new penny for the looking. Margery can have the box. I had the end.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Keep the end. I have heard the mast. A thin day is still a day the doors opened. Ten shillings the week is what I pay the men who stayed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The doors opened. I was not in the play. I am going home to a page.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And thee. Leave the lion where thou heard of him. I will not have him in the tiring-house.
